sloka: तमरिघ्नं कृतात्मानं क्षिप्रं द्रक्ष्यसि राघवम् ।लक्ष्मणं च धनुष्पाणिं लङ्काद्वारमुपस्थितम्* ।। ५.३९.४८।।।।
transliteration: tamarighnaṁ kṛtātmānaṁ kṣipraṁ drakṣyasi rāghavam ।lakṣmaṇaṁ ca dhanuṣpāṇiṁ laṅkādvāramupasthitam* ।। 5.39.48।।।।

translations.english: "Very soon you would see the slayer of foes, who is an accomplished wielder of the bow (Rama) along with Lakshmana at the entrance of Lanka.
